chapter: The union and the 1920s-30s band scene
title: How Les Hite came to Los Angeles and formed his band
summary: Howard says Hite came from Chicago and formed his band in the early thirties with Lionel Hampton on drums.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: What about Les Hite? That's a man you must have known.
He came here, yeah, but he lives in Los Angeles.
He wasn't originally from Los Angeles.
Did you know how he came to -- came about being the kind of leader he was? He was a saxophone player (inaudible)?
And did he form his big band right in Los Angeles?
He formed the band and he took -- what's
his name, his sidekick, oh, I can't think of that boy -- (Inaudible.)
What did he play, the sidekick?
No, not Peppy. It was Lionel Hampton.
You mean, when Les formed the band, Lionel was in the band?
Les came here from Chicago or someplace. That's where he came from, Chicago. Came right out of my mouth.
When was that, when Les formed his first band?
I was playing at the -- I was playing with my band up at the -- it went away, just that quick.
But you have an idea about when Les --
And Lionel was still in Los Angeles then?
